correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs completely. Writing the three positive ratios in logarithmic coordinates makes the log denominator a cyclic sum of a strictly convex log-sum-exp function. Averaging the three cyclic permutations at fixed total log-product yields the equal triple and strict Jensen gives uniqueness. Substitution into Routh's exact formula gives the stated envelope. On a fixed non-Ceva product surface the area ratio is continuous and positive, attains the envelope at the equal triple, and tends to zero along the explicit path with one ratio tending to infinity and another to zero, so the image is exactly the claimed interval. Algebraic inversion gives the defect inequality. The finite verifier is supplementary and not used for the universal claim.
